One theme, palette, metal tone, repeated: Otu isiokwu, palette, ụda ígwè, mmewere ugboro ugboro
Hero: one showstopper for photos: dike: otu onye na-egosi ihe ngosi maka foto

A collection is a small family of pieces: Nchịkọta bụ obere ezinụlọ nke iberibe na-ejikọta ọnụ. Nye ya otu isiokwu, agba abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ, otu ụda ọla na otu mmewere ugboro ugboro, dị ka otu ụdị resin na ibe ọ bụla.
The hero piece is the showstopper, like: Iberibe dike bụ ihe ngosi ihe ngosi, dị ka olu akwa bezel.
Mid-range pieces carry the look at a mod: Iberibe dị n'etiti na-ebu anya na ọnụ ahịa na-agafeghị oke, dị ka peyote cuff.
Entry pieces, like resin studs, are quic: Iberibe ntinye, dị ka studs resin, na-adị ngwa ime. Ọtụtụ ndị na-azụ ahịa na-abịa maka dike na foto gị wee pụọ na mpempe ntinye.
A first collection of five to ten design: Nchịkọta mbụ nke ise ruo iri atụmatụ zuru ezu.
First, materials, from your receipts: be: Nke mbụ, ihe ndị sitere na nnata gị: beads, waya, nchoputa, resin, eri na nkwakọ ngwaahịa.
Second, labour. Hours from your time log: Nke abụọ, ọrụ. Oge awa site na ndekọ oge gị, oge ọnụego elekere ị ga-anabata n'aka onye ọzọ maka ọrụ nka.
Third, overhead, a percentage for runnin: Nke atọ, n'elu, pasent maka ọnụ ahịa ọsọ dị ka data, ụgbọ njem na ọkụ eletrik. Ọtụtụ ndị na-emepụta obere na-eji 10 ruo 20%.
Add those three together and you have yo: Tinye atọ ndị ahụ ọnụ na ị nwere ọnụ ahịa ọnụ ahịa gị.
Then add a profit markup, for example 30: Mgbe ahụ gbakwunye akara uru, dịka ọmụmaatụ 30 ruo 50%, na gburugburu na ọnụ ọgụgụ dị ọcha. Nke ahụ bụ ọnụ ahịa azụmaahịa gị.
A peyote cuff and a boutique offer: Otu peyote cuff na onyinye boutique
For example, Ifeoma prices her peyote cu: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Ifeoma na-akwụ ụgwọ peyote cuff ya. boutique Lagos na-enye mbufe ma na-edobe 30%.
Her own figures. Naira prices are approx: Ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ya. Ọnụ ahịa Naira dị ihe ruru.
Here is a worked example with Ifeoma's o: Nke a bụ ọmụmaatụ ọrụ nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ Ifeoma nke ya. Otu boutique dị na Lagos na-enye ịre cuff ya na mbupu ma debe 30% nke ọnụ ahịa ere.
Materials come to 5,500 naira. Labour is: Akụrụngwa na-abịa 5,500 naira. Ọrụ bụ awa asatọ na puku naira 1,500, nke bụ puku naira iri na abụọ.
Overhead at 10% is 1,750 naira, so her c: Ihe karịrị 10% bụ 1,750 naira, ya mere ọnụ ahịa ya bụ naira 19,250.
With a 40% markup, she rounds the retail: N'iji akara 40% mee ihe, ọ na-agbakọ ọnụ ahịa azụmaahịa ahụ na puku naira iri abụọ na asaa.
But on consignment she would receive onl: Mana na mbubata ọ ga-anata naanị 70%, nke bụ naira 18,900. Nke ahụ bụ narị naira atọ na iri ise erughị ọnụ ahịa ya. Ego ga-efunahụ ya.
To get her cost plus 20% profit after co: Iji nweta ọnụ ahịa ya gbakwunyere uru 20% mgbe ọrụ, ọnụ ahịa mkpọsa ga-abụrịrị 33,000 naira. Ọ na-eji otu ọnụ ahịa ahụ ebe niile, yabụ na ọ naghị ebipụ ụlọ ahịa ahụ.
Soft window light, no flash: Ìhè windo dị nro, enweghị ọkụ

Never change bead colours or make silver: Agbanwela agba bead ma ọ bụ mee ka ọlaọcha yie ọla edo. Onye ahịa nke nwetara ihe dị iche ga-arịọ maka nkwụghachi.

For custom and bridal orders, collect a: Maka iwu omenala na nke agbamakwụkwọ, na-anakọta nkenke n'ụdị dị mfe: mmemme, ụbọchị, agba ekike, nha na mmefu ego.

Send a progress photo at a key stage, so: Zipu foto agamnihu na ọkwa isi, yabụ mgbanwe na-eme tupu ibe agwụ. Ma gbakwunye otu izu tupu oge ngwụcha ọ bụla.
Collect the balance as agreed, and pack: Chịkọta nguzozi dịka ekwenyere, ma jiri kaadị nlekọta kwakọba ibe ahụ.
